summary.text: Sleeping Lady is a rank seven Northern Plains lone immortal who cultivates sound path and created Divine Needle Valley for a divine hedgehog.

claims.text: Meng tribe’s Investigation Courtyard stops at an artificial lush valley between Meng tribe and Murong tribe, and Meng tribe’s second supreme elder names it her Divine Needle Valley. She does not have outstanding battle strength, but she controls an immemorial desolate beast divine hedgehog, a sword path beast that can shoot the spines on its body. She lives between the two super forces so that neither side dares to go fully against her. Meng tribe and Murong tribe have both shown goodwill, trying to win her over. The hedgehog’s spines are rank eight immortal materials called front-back divine obstruction needles. She uses sound path killer moves to keep the beast in deep sleep after feeding it, harvests the longest spines, and sells most of them to the two tribes while placing a small portion in treasure yellow heaven. She has not completely subdued the beast and is not an enslavement path Gu Immortal. When Meng tribe comes to report Meng Tu’s death, she declares her innocence, then asks them to search the valley with her.

While she and the Meng tribe immortals follow planted clues out of the valley, Fang Yuan disguises himself as her with familiar face and plucks every spine. Cold sweat drips down her forehead, she spreads Gu worm auras, and her expression stays impassive while she is inwardly bitter. She demands an explanation from Meng tribe, reveals the matter in treasure yellow heaven, and informs Murong tribe. She cannot move the hedgehog into her immortal aperture, and she treats it as her trump card between the two tribes. Fang Yuan’s first-life memories name her among the experts who resisted Heavenly Court, so he leaves the hedgehog with her to grow a new batch. He then spreads rumors that she kept the needles herself. She spits blood from anxiety and anger when she learns of those rumors.
During the chaos Fang Yuan stirs around the Refinement Path Convention, Northern Plains’ Sleeping Lady attacks Combat Immortal Sect’s formation and plunders a resource point completely.

Fang Yuan comes to Divine Needle Valley, sends yama children, and traps her in yama battlefield before she can join up with the hedgehog. She offers the method to control the beast in exchange for her life. When he exposes that act, she roars and shows battle strength unlike the outside world’s evaluation, fighting out of the yama children’s encirclement but not out of the battlefield. Luo Po seal breaks her defenses like thin paper and she dies on the spot. She self-detonates all of her Immortal Gu. Fang Yuan keeps her corpse and immortal aperture, disguises himself as her to store the remaining needles, suppresses the hedgehog, and takes the valley with pulling mountain Immortal Gu.
